name: Solar Panel Efficiency Query
input: What is the average efficiency of modern commercial solar panels?
reference_answer: Commercial solar panel efficiency typically ranges between 15% and 22%.
reference_context: Most commercial solar panels currently operate at an efficiency rating between 15% and 22%.

name: AI Benchmark Evolution Query
input: How do AI benchmarks evolve over time?
